collection.title: BMW 7 Series 1994 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW 7 Series 1994 - 2001 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. Please note, the passenger side is approximately 25mm shorter than the original.
